owner_request: Show the proposed explanation and obtain a new independent judgment against all saved criteria.
implementation: Exact saved EN/ES paragraph replaces microcaption outsideglass; existing Hanken16/24normal,16px heading gap, captionmax46ch and text-wrap:pretty. All chartgeometry/copy/actions/qualifiers preserved.
render_method: Preview-only exact production-built HTML/CSS/JS served by Playwright local-file request fulfillment. No preview HTTP server, no remote deployment, no live Site mutation. Viewport emulation, not physical device or browser-chrome zoom.

independence_disclosure.disclosure: Text-level judgments were formed and communicated before an agent-status inventory unexpectedly exposed colleagues’ completion summaries. Their reports were not opened and their verdicts were not used as evidence. Rendered judgment is this reviewer's own. This is independent agent review with partial blinding, not human research or human clinician approval.

residual_issues.issue: Native deployment, full production flow, actual browser zoom, real-device performance and assistive-technology experience are outside this preview.
residual_issues.resolution: Do not present preview evidence as proof of these.

residual_issues.resolution: For an eventual implementation, add the IFCC reference in existing Sources and context rather than adding visible prose or another panel.
